public.text: Resource allocation, eligibility, and care decisions are identified as contexts requiring audit. These are also high-impact decisions that may require stronger restrictions than audit alone.
public.suggestedRevision: Require human accountability, contestability, explanation appropriate to the decision, bias assessment, documented decision authority, and prohibition or strict control of fully automated high-impact decisions where required by law or policy.
